name: code-health
description: Evidence-backed repository audits with risk-ranked findings and explicit verification guidance.

interface.longDescription: Audit changed code, a component, or an entire repository using concrete evidence, risk-based prioritization, and verification guidance. Reviews cover security, reliability, architecture, maintainability, performance, scalability, testing, and developer experience without modifying production code.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository and report evidence-backed code-health findings.
Review the current changes for security and reliability risks.
Audit this component and prioritize the highest-risk improvements.
